Color Schemes Reference

Source: vignettes/color-schemes.Rmd
color-schemes.Rmd

CTTIR v5 families

reflowR schemes are the nine topic families of the CTTIR v5 design language, the same set used by hexmakR artwork and the themakR documentation template. Every colour and font comes from design_tokens.csv, shipped with the package in inst/cttir/. Colour supports identity; text, headings and links always use neutral tokens.

Key Label Accent Face, light Face, dark
spectral Spectral imaging #0072B2 #D7E6EF #193443
spatial Spatial biology #009E73 #D7EDE7 #193F34
omics Molecular data #CC79A7 #F3E7EE #4A3641
clinical Clinical science #D55E00 #F4E4D7 #4C2F19
methods Learning & inference #56B4E9 #E3F0F7 #2D4451
simulation Systems & simulation #E69F00 #F7EDD7 #503F19
evidence Evidence & discovery #F0E442 #F8F6E0 #524F28
platform Research infrastructure #000000 #D7D7D7 #191919
brand Science, connected #0072B2 #D7E6EF #193443

brand is the CTTIR default and the default of reflow_init(). Pick the family that best describes the project:

Context Family
Clinical trial, patient data clinical
Imaging and spectroscopy spectral
Tissue and spatial assays spatial
Sequencing and molecular profiles omics
Statistical or machine-learning methods methods
Simulation and systems models simulation
Systematic reviews, meta-analyses evidence
Software, data and infrastructure platform
General purpose brand

Earlier scheme names

The five schemes of reflowR 0.1.0 remain accepted. clinical keeps its name and now uses the v5 vermillion; the others are aliases that print a one-time message:

Earlier name v5 family
basic brand
code methods
special evidence
other platform

Generated site styling

reflow_init() writes analysis/theme.css (workflowr) and assets/_theme.scss (Quarto report). Both follow the themakR surface:

Role Light Dark
Page and flat navbar #FAFAFA #212121
Text #212121 #DADADA
Headings, navbar text #212121 #FFFFFF
Links #1565C0 #42A5F5
Code surface #E9E9E9 #2B2B2B
Borders, h2 rule #D8D8D8 #4F4F4F

Dark mode follows the reader’s system setting and can be forced with data-bs-theme="dark" or body.colorscheme-dark. The family accent marks only non-text identity elements: the 3px navbar rule, the h1 underline, active navigation and table-of-contents markers, callout borders and table header rules. Pages use the --cttir-* custom properties of themakR plus --cttir-topic.

Body text uses "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif, code "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace and the navbar name JetBrains Mono at weight 600. Nothing is downloaded: sites without these fonts fall back to system fonts.

In R code

code/00_setup.R provides the same values for figures and tables:

wf_colors$primary   # family accent
wf_colors$face      # tinted surface, e.g. facet strips
wf_palette          # Okabe-Ito topic colours, accent first
wf_fonts$body       # "Inter"

ggplot(df, aes(x, y, colour = group)) + geom_point() +
  scale_color_wf() + theme_wf()

Inspect or preview a family directly:

reflow_schemes()
s <- reflow_scheme("spatial")
s$accent
s$palette
reflow_preview("spatial")
